recognize_zh: 整片黏著成片的大型細胞，核為泡狀染色質並有明顯的中央嗜酸性核仁；箭頭指出一顆多核、類似 Reed-Sternberg 的奇異巨細胞，符合大 B 細胞淋巴瘤間變型的多形性表現。
features: Diffuse sheets of large cells with abundant amphophilic to eosinophilic cytoplasm
Round to oval nuclei with vesicular chromatin and prominent central eosinophilic nucleoli
Arrow: multinucleated/multilobated bizarre cell with Reed-Sternberg-like features
Occasional mitotic figures and apoptotic cells
Paucity of background small lymphocytes, giving a cohesive, carcinoma-like appearance
describe_en: Sections show diffuse sheets of large atypical lymphoid cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, vesicular chromatin, and prominent eosinophilic nucleoli. Scattered bizarre multinucleated cells with Reed-Sternberg-like morphology are present (arrow), along with mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies. Background small lymphocytes are sparse and the growth pattern is cohesive. Findings are consistent with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, anaplastic variant, pending immunohistochemical confirmation of B-cell lineage.

ddx.vs: ALCL has horseshoe-shaped hallmark cells and is CD30-strong, ALK-positive or negative, with loss of B-cell markers, whereas this entity expresses CD20/PAX5.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are CD15/CD30-positive with weak PAX5 and CD20/CD45 negativity, unlike the strong B-cell program of DLBCL.
Cohesive sheets with prominent nucleoli can mimic carcinoma, which is separated by keratin positivity and CD45 negativity.
